newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 22.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Interim managing director of state owned oil company PETROCI says the main goal of the new management team is to double oil and gas production by the year 2000 and to resolve labour problems within the company; Gilbert Yougoubare said the government had decided to split PETROCI Into four groups, three of which would be open to private investors. Currently it produces 20,000 barrels of oil a day, and 60 million cubic feet a day of gas.

- Finance Minister Ngoran Niamien and other experts tell Ivorian economic operators that they must prepare to face greater competition when the Lome IV pact between the European Union and the African, Caribbean and Pacific countries ends in the year 2000.
- Company managers attend a seminar on using the internet in daily financial management
